title: The Christian Wedding
attribution_note: Fr Ilie Cleopa (1912–1998). His Nunta creștină, a catechesis on the eleven canonical rules of the Orthodox wedding. Translated here fresh from the Romanian with credit and a link to the source, not offered as public domain. Source: https://www.sfaturiortodoxe.ro/pcleopa/32nunta.htm

pairs.en: THE CHRISTIAN WEDDING

Not every wedding among people, and not in every religious confession, is the
wedding a mystery. So among Protestants, among Catholics, among Anglicans, and among
many other confessions and peoples, the wedding has no power of mystery. It is only a
symbol with them, an act of friendship and a kind of proof between husband and wife.
But nowhere does the wedding have the grace-giving power of a Mystery, and nowhere is
it so honoured as in the right-believing Church of the East.

That the wedding may be truly a great and hallowed mystery, you must know that the
wedding has eleven canonical rules. And only when it is done according to these rules
is the wedding a true Christian wedding and a true great Mystery.

Marriage is the root of human nature, as the divine Apostle Paul calls it.
He says this: If the root is holy, the branches will be holy too.
But if the root is wild, wild and evil will be its branches.
He calls marriage a Mystery, for it is one of the seven Mysteries. But not a mystery,
rather this great mystery is — he says of the wedding — and I say to you: in Christ
and in the Church. If the crowning has been done in church, it represents the spiritual
union in heaven of the Church with Christ.

sections.heading: The wedding at Cana and the lament

pairs.en:
You don't joke around and then unite through crowning with a virgin. You've gone
to do your military service and you rush to get married. If you do it like that, it's
not right ! The wedding has been in Christ's Church for 2,000 years. The mystery of
Christ is only when the crowning is done in church.

When I went to Jerusalem, I went to Cana of Galilee, where the water was turned
into wine; for the Saviour worked His first miracle at the wedding in Cana. That is
why He raised the wedding to the rank of Mystery, just like Holy Communion, Baptism,
Confession, Holy Unction, Priesthood — just as great a Mystery is the wedding too.

There I went and I saw the stone vessels where the water was turned into wine and
I kissed them. They are two vessels of flint, yellow. The Gospel says that there were
six vessels; two I saw at Saint Anna's, at the museum, two at Cana, and two
have been lost for 2,000 years.

These vessels in which the Saviour turned water into wine are placed in the church;
they have beautiful icons and gold curtains, so that the world may venerate, may kiss
the icons
and after that the vessels.

But the Mystery of Marriage that Christians perform today — woe and bitter are we !
How the holiness of this Mystery has been corrupted ! How we have departed from the
holiness of this Mystery, as far as heaven is from earth !

That you may understand this, listen carefully to what are the eleven
canonical rules of the Orthodox Christian wedding, according to the canons of the Churches of Christ.

sections.heading: The first rule: no marriage among kin

pairs.en:
1. The first condition or canonical rule, and here we speak from the word
of Saint John Chrysostom, is that relatives must not marry one another.

The priest of the church is the father of the whole village or of the parish. You,
when you are going to marry off your daughters or sons, are bound to go first to
the priest. The priest must know first of all how many weddings there are in the village.

A boy has spoken with a girl, but he must go to the priest. If the priest
has many families in the commune, as happens in many places, and he does not know who is
related to whom, he can put a notice on the church door: " We ask
all the parishioners to inform us, if these two young people are not relatives !"
If the parishioners do not speak up when they know, it is their sin.

The line of kinship and the family tree of a family is divided into five
: Ascending and descending kinship, collateral, by in-law, by divine
Baptism, and by adopted children.

The ascending kinships are: father, grandfather, great-grandfather, great-great-grandfather.
The descending are: son, grandson, great-grandson, and great-great-grandson.
This kind of kinship can never marry, because of the impossibility
of age.

A great-great-grandfather has the right to marry a great-great-granddaughter, but she
must be 16 years old, and he 100 years old. So you can see that he cannot
marry her because of age. So these cannot marry, to infinity.

The collateral kinships, which cross the blood kinships, the ascending
and descending, that is: father, son ( sister ), first cousin, second cousin
and third cousin. Father and mother are of the first degree; brother and sister are
of the second degree; first cousins are of the fourth degree; second cousins are
of the sixth degree. All these are not allowed to marry one another.
Only third cousins may marry, who are of the eighth degree. So third cousins
may marry.

Whoever enters into this collateral kinship, again enters into blood kinship.
Remember this ! The village priest tells you, but since you have come here, I
tell you too.

The kinships by in-law, from two and three families on each side. That is: a
man was married to a woman, the woman's parents became in-laws with his parents.
These are kinships from two sides. But if the woman dies and the man takes another
woman, they have become three families in in-law, because he has become in-law also with the parents
of the second woman. Here marriage stops at the fifth degree; at the sixth
degree the Holy Fathers release it.

The kinships from divine Baptism. These kinships are forbidden to
marry up to the seventh degree inclusive.

The godfather, if he has baptised a child, that boy, when he has grown up, cannot marry
the godfather's daughter, nor the son's daughter, the granddaughter from the son. Only may he
marry the godfather's great-granddaughter. Likewise, if this boy of the godparents were to have a
son, he cannot marry the godfather's daughter, but only the godfather's granddaughter.

Then a great sin do the priests and those Christians commit who put many godparents at a wedding,
as I have heard in Bukovina, that they put 40 godparents at one wedding. Unheard-of madness
! They all become relatives. Their children can no longer marry, ever.

Who taught you to put many godparents at a wedding ? So that a lot of money comes out ?
You go to gehenna, to hell ! This much you are allowed: one godfather to put; the godfather with his wife
( if they are religiously married ). That much ! A single godfather to be put at the wedding.

I'll show you the dogmas and canons of the Church; I have my hand on the Pidalion and on
the church law codes.

So let this sin no longer be done ! And the priest who allows this,
the Church condemns him. Do you know how great a sin is the mixing of kinships
from divine Baptism ? It is greater than that of blood. I will give you an example.
If it should come to this madness, that a father should sin with his daughter, it stops him
20 years from the Holy Mysteries. But if he has lived with his goddaughter from baptism, it stops him
25 years, for the kinship from baptism is greater than that of blood, for it is a spiritual
kinship.

You must know this thing, that you plunge yourselves into gehenna, if you put many
godparents and make kinships, and afterwards your children or grandchildren marry.
You answer for it !

The kinship from adopted children. You have taken a boy, you have adopted him, you have put him
under your name, he bears your name in society. He is yours. As is
your boy, so is he before God, after you have adopted him.

So that child, if he has a sister or a brother, cannot marry a child
of yours, nor if he had a grandson. Only his great-grandson may marry
your great-granddaughter, again up to the fourth line. You must know these things,
for the poor soul is heavily burdened.

The wedding of those who have married from kinship has only two remedies, both heavy,
according to Saint Basil the Great: " Whoever has entangled himself with kinship in marriage,
either he separates — even if he has a child, for the Church separates them — or let him
live as brother and sister in purity until death !"

So, of whatever kind and line of kinship someone is, if he oversteps the kinships
and they marry, incest is made and mixing of blood, and there is curse
and misfortune on both families that have become in-laws, and on the young people who have
married.

2. The second canonical condition of the Orthodox wedding is that the young people
should consent; that the groom and the bride should please each other, the boy and the girl. A great sin and a great mistake
do the parents commit who give the daughter to someone she does not like, or force the son to take
this or that girl, because she has great wealth, or because she is beautiful, or who knows what
other conditions.

These parents who urge their children to marry against their will,
are murderers who lead them into temptation, for they only marry out of shame for their parents,
at their urging, and then they do not please each other and they separate. And all the sins
that follow from this separation are due to the parents who urged them
and fall on their shoulders. Once the young people have consented, it is from God.

3. But there is also a third rule of the canonical wedding. Their parents must also
consent, both the boy's and the girl's. There is no blessing of
God if the young people please each other and the parents do not agree. So,
then the wedding is a Mystery, when God puts it in the minds of both the parents and the young people
to consent to the wedding.

Then the wedding is blessed, when both the young people and the parents consent, when
they make a free agreement between this in-law bond and between their children.

4. The fourth rule of the canonical wedding. The young people should marry very
early. According to the canons of the Church, according to the teaching of Saint John Chrysostom,
the boy should marry when he is 15 years old and the girl when she is
13 years old.

But why is this ? Have you asked yourselves ? Here is why: So that they should not
sin before marriage, so that they should not marry defiled. For the wedding is honourable, when both
are virgins, both the boy and the girl. The Church always defends innocence
and purity. It takes great care, lest they marry after the boy
or the girl has fallen into sin with someone. For then there is no " Lord help"
in the marriage.

But if now, according to the laws of the state, it has been decided that the girl should be 16 years old, this
rule too is good. For she is not too young, she is just right. And the boy
should not pass the age of 18 years or at most 20, but he should guard himself
with great strength until marriage in virginity, as their mothers raised them.

5. The fifth rule of the canonical wedding. Before the wedding, at
least a week before, the parents of the groom and of the bride must go to the spiritual father for confession,
and their children, the groom and the bride, to be
prepared for communion.

But let them make a confession as it should be, written, for confession is a second
baptism. Do it well, saying everything you have done, from when you were a small child until
the time came for you to marry or to be wed.

6. The sixth rule of the canonical wedding. On the day when the wedding is to take place,
the groom and the bride must go to church, the parents of the boy who
are called the big parents-in-law, and the parents of the girl, that is the small parents-in-law, to listen with great
devotion and with great fear of God to the whole divine service of the Church,
Matins, the Divine Liturgy, the sermon, and the whole order.

7. The seventh rule of the canonical wedding. On the day when they are to be crowned,
if the priest, at confession, has found these two young people worthy to give them
Holy Communion, that is, to commune them with the Body and Blood of the Lord.
They, on the day of the wedding, receive two mysteries, namely Communion and Crowning.

sections.heading: The eighth rule: the crown only for the pure

pairs.en:
8. The eighth canonical rule of the Church of Christ for the true,
Christian wedding, is that the spiritual priest, who has confessed these
young people and knows their life, if he knows that, God forbid, one of them has fallen
into sin before the crowning, the groom or the bride, must not place the crowning on
their head, for he commits a mortal sin.

What do you think, that that crowning is put for show, for pride,
so that people should see us that the Church crowns us ? Woe to your head, if he has
crowned you, being unworthy, for to your condemnation you have been crowned !

The Church of Christ, which is " pillar and ground of the truth",
crowns only the virginal, who have kept their virginity until the wedding,
both the boy and the girl, as their mother raised them. Only to them the Church is allowed
to do this great honour of placing the crown on their head, this crown of
victory over the sin of the flesh, over the passions and corruption, for they have
struggled in life with fasting, with prayer, and with self-control and have kept themselves to be a temple
of the Holy Spirit, and they are crowned because they have conquered sin !

In olden times, when a ruler or an emperor won an empire, having
some victory or great bravery, it was the custom to crown him. So also
at this mystery. The Church crowns the victors, the brave, who
have struggled until the crowning to keep their virginity untouched by the sins of the flesh,
unclean.

The Church, which is the body of Christ, pillar and ground of truth, does not crown
fornicators and adulterers, but only holy people, who have kept their body and soul
holy until the crowning.

But if the priest knows from confession that either the groom or the bride has fallen into
fornication, let him not place the crowning on their head ! Let him place it only on the groom, if he has been
honourable, or only on the bride.

O, how good it would be ! The whole church would see who has a fly on his cap
! Everyone would know how honourable they had been, when they see the bride with the crown
on her head and the groom without, or the other way around. But if both have fallen, the priest has no right
to place the crowning on either of them. Read Saint John Chrysostom ( Homily
9, on 1 Timothy ) and Saint Nicodemus the Aghiorite ( in " Christian Morality",
Word IV, pp. 80-82 ).

The priest who places the crowning on the head of fornicators, who have fallen, or
at a second wedding, is under canon. He has no right ! He does uncanonical and unapproved things
by the Church of Christ.

I have heard that now the crowning is placed also at a second wedding, for some. Who taught you
? Who gives you leave to do this ?

There are some who have the pretension to have the crowning placed on their head after they have had their fill,
men of women and women of men. You have no more reason to crown them ! He may
be confessed a hundred times, if he has fallen, he has fallen; he is no longer virginal.
If he is confessed, he is barred seven years from communion. Let him do penance, but not
have the crown placed on his head. Only at the first wedding and if they are virginal is he allowed
to place the crowning on their heads.

sections.heading: The ninth rule: the wedding feast without musicians

pairs.en:
9. The ninth rule of the canonical wedding. The wedding is not done with musicians,
God forbid ! Do you put the devil to sing at the mystery of Christ ? A mystery is
the wedding !

Read canon 117 of the Council of Carthage and other canons, which condemn
the Christians who make weddings with musicians. And it says there, that if someone has put
musicians at the wedding, the priest should not stay at that wedding, but leave immediately, for
the work of Veliar ( the devil ) cannot be reconciled with that of Christ.

If I were reading you the prayer of confession ( when I confess a man, the poor fellow
begins to tell his sins ), and just then someone would come with a lute next to
you, there, while you are confessing, what would you say: " Look, man, the devil
won't leave me even here at confession ! "

A mystery is confession, a mystery is the wedding too. Why do you put the devil to sing at the mystery
of Christ ? Who taught you ? Who are the musicians of the wedding ? Do you know ? The teachers
of the church and the chanters. The canons of the Church do not allow the wedding to be done
with musicians.

The priest, after he has crowned the young people and finished the Divine Liturgy, if
he is invited to the wedding, to the wedding feast, let him come. The groom and the bride, from
the church to home, go with the crowns on their heads.

Where the wedding feast is set, the groom should sit on the right of the priest with the big
parents-in-law, and the bride on the left with the small parents-in-law. At the wedding feast there should be served
only three kinds of food and three glasses of wine, nothing more, and during this time
the priest must give orders to the teachers and chanters to sing the wedding hymns
and other fitting praises from the church services, which are proper
for this holy and great Mystery of the wedding.

There the teacher says the Our Father, the priest blesses the wedding feast, as
you have seen us do at the monastery, and they sit at the table.

I said three glasses of wine, but don't go making the glass half a litre
and saying there are three ! Behold, Saint Theodore the Studite shows how big the glass
should be at the wedding, and indeed for all who drink wine: " And let the glass
not take more than four ounces" ( + ). So one
glass of wine at the wedding should have 32 grams. A little bigger than a shot glass.
( + ) The Roman ounce had eight grams.

This much you are allowed to take at the wedding, three glasses of 32 grams each, that is barely 96
grams. Three glasses that you take at the wedding must not have more than 100
grams of wine.

That is the drunkenness at the wedding. For the wedding is a mystery, not a racket and a devil's theatre,
where they should get drunk and cut each other with knives like madmen and where the greatest
debaucheries and evils and fights and insults are done. That is not a wedding, but a theatre.
And worse than a theatre it is. For it is a devil's theatre, for Satan makes fun
of them, for instead of a holy mystery, they make it Satan's shop !

One kind of food and one glass of wine. The priest, after the first kind of food, takes
the glass, he blesses it ( + ), and wishes first the groom and
the bride a happy marriage, well-behaved children, health, deliverance from dangers and from
illnesses, from sorrows, from hatred, from evil, and may the big parents-in-law live, the small parents-in-law
and the big wedding sponsors who have crowned, and all the guests who sit at the table.
( + ) blesses

After that the second kind of food is served and the second glass of wine is given.
At the third glass, the priest gives a short sermon and chants the Axion of the Mother of God
and then the thanksgiving.

After they have risen from the table, the teacher says the prayer of thanksgiving, the priest
blesses the remains and the crumbs, takes a glass of wine, drinks it in
honour of the groom and the bride and of the big and small parents-in-law and wishes them a happy
marriage, increase, health, well-behaved and healthy children.

If there are more weddings, from here the priest goes there too. So the ninth condition,
the wedding to be done without musicians.

sections.heading: The tenth rule: three days of purity

pairs.en:
10. The tenth rule of the canonical wedding. If the groom and the bride have not
had impediments and they have been allowed to commune with the Holy and Most Pure
Mysteries, their flesh and their blood have been mingled with the Flesh and Blood of Jesus
Christ, for the most pure mysteries are truly the Body and Blood of the Lord;
and because they have received, on the day of the wedding, two mysteries, both Crowning and Holy Communion,
they must not come together with one another for three days and three nights after the wedding,
if they want their life to go well all their days and to be true Christians.

The groom, as a guard, must sleep in the chamber with his father, so the book says,
and the bride with her mother, and afterwards they are free to come together for the bearing
of children and the increase of the human race, as God ordained in Genesis, when
He said: Be fruitful and multiply and fill the earth and subdue it. [Gen. 1:28]

sections.heading: The eleventh rule: the days of the week

pairs.en:
11. The eleventh rule of the wedding. Do you think the wedding is higgledy-piggledy
and promiscuous, like the pigs ? Oh no... A mystery is the wedding. Honourable is the wedding
and the bed undefiled, and Christ has blessed them both, says the great
Apostol Paul. All his life, from when the Christian is crowned until death, he has no
right to come together with his wife except on Tuesday and Thursday only, if it is not a fast
and if it is not a feast day then.

And today's doctors, according to science, show that the healthiest children come from
this, that the man should not have contact with his wife except twice a week.
Even science comes to the help of the Church and confirms this thing: those who
come together too often weaken the strength and vigour of the children and become, for their pleasures,
abnormal.

Monday is kept in purity for the holy guardian angels and for health.
Wednesday and Friday for the most holy and awesome passions of the Lord,
our God and Saviour Jesus Christ, for on Wednesday He was betrayed
and on Friday He was crucified and His most precious blood flowed and He watered the Cross on
Mount Golgotha for our sins, He who made heaven and earth.

Saturday is kept in purity for the honour of the Mother of God and the remembrance of our
departed. And Sunday for the most holy and glorious resurrection of our Lord and Saviour
Jesus Christ, through whom all the human race was saved.

And Tuesday and Thursday are left for the coming together of husband with wife, from when
the day begins, from midnight. So from Monday evening at midnight there is
release until Tuesday night at midnight. Likewise also Thursday.

So for the increase of the human race, for the strengthening of human society,
for the honourable birth rate of our people, let account be kept both of the decision
of the Church and of the doctors who say that only twice a week the man
should have contact with his wife, and only for the bearing of children.
This is the eleventh canonical rule of the wedding.

— Now I ask you, are such weddings still made today ?
— No, father !
— I know they are not ! That is why you scratch each other's eyes out, that is why you fall ill, that
is why you divorce, that is why one goes to the right and the other to the left; that is why
one goes to other women, and the woman to other men, and fights and stress and drunkenness
and disasters and death !

I told you at the beginning that the wedding is the root of human nature, and if the root
has started badly and is wild and corrupt — for two have taken each other who are sated,
the woman of the man and the man of the woman — from the beginning the branches are evil too.

Do not expect happiness in marriage or peace or reconciliation or wealth or
honour, but curse, strife, poverty, illness, and all the evils that come from the dishonouring
of the Mystery of Marriage.

That wedding is only in form ! The root is cursed and corrupt, for it is
a root of adulterers, not a root of holy and virginal people. That is why
all of society is corrupted and all the families, because the order
of Christ is not kept at weddings. And the wedding, instead of being a great mystery, as the great Apostle
Paul says, is a bitterness and a wildness of human nature.

Whichever of the Christians have the fear of God and will hear these words and will keep
with holiness these canonical rules left by the Church of Christ, those
will have the happiest children in the world, the healthiest, the best-behaved,
the most talented and, at the same time, this family will have honour both from people
and from God and will be an example to follow in the family, in society, in the country
and anywhere.

These children are endowed by God with all the gifts, for they have
come into the world on the way that God has left.

I have a few families who confess to me and have made their wedding exactly according to the rule
of the Church, and there are others too in the country.

May God help you to hold with great strength to these rules, if you want
to be good Christians, good citizens of the country, and people of great use to the Church
of Christ. Through these people, if these rules will be respected, the country will live,
the Church will live, and the Spirit of God will be their help in the present age
and in the age to come. Amen.
